title: Limit Cycles in a Discontinuous Generalized Liénard Systems with Bivariate Perturbation
summary: We study the number of limit cycles of the piecewise smooth differential system \[ \dot{x}=y, \quad \dot{y}=-x-\varepsilon\bigl(f(x)y+\operatorname{sgn}(x)g(x,y)\bigr),\] where $f(x)$ is a polynomial of degree $n\geq 1$, $g(x,y)$ is a bivariate polynomial of degree $m\geq 2$, and $\varepsilon$ is a sufficiently small parameter. Using the first-order averaging theorem for discontinuous systems, we obtain that the number $H_{m,n}=\lfloor n/2\rfloor+\lfloor m/2\rfloor$ is a lower bound for the number of limit cycles bifurcating from the linear center $\dot{x}=y, \ \dot{y}=-x$.
